metric_definitions.units: Unshifted full-length linear PCM, source PCM16 divided by32768; float64 reductions over frames and both channels
metric_definitions.cpu_vulkan: Reference=CPU; candidate=Vulkan. Error=candidate-reference, RMS=sqrt(mean(error²)), maximum=max(abs(error)), bias=mean(error), relative RMS=error RMS/reference RMS
metric_definitions.decibels: 20log10(relative RMS); null when reference RMS is zero or error is exactly zero. exact_zero_error distinguishes zero error
metric_definitions.lag: Channel-demeaned zero-padded FFT cross correlation summed across channels, normalized by full-signal energies, searched within±256samples. Positive lag means Vulkan occurs later than CPU. No signals are shifted for raw errors. Periodic or weak signals may give ambiguous peaks
metric_definitions.recombination: Unshifted sum of four stems minus source; bias_per_channel is DC residual. This is not a separation-quality score
metric_definitions.joins: At kHOP and kHOP+OVERLAP for k>=1 inside source. Jump=sample[b]-sample[b-1]; neighborhood derivatives use±20ms, clipped at source edges. No pass thresholds or attribution of artifacts
metric_definitions.references: Only supplied aligned reference WAVs produce reference metrics; raw amplitude/phase alignment retained, no gain fitting or time shifting
